mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (order_id, pay_channel, pay_amount, transaction_no, pay_status, is_deleted, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{record.orderId}, #{record.payChannel}, #{record.payAmount}, #{record.transactionNo}, #{record.payStatus}, #{record.isDeleted}, #{record.gmtCreate}, #{record.gmtModified})
